title: DURANKI-REAL-COMPLETION-01 proposed schemas and route catalogue
$comment: PROPOSAL, not implemented or adopted. Route/header catalogues are annotations; semantic/state/crypto rules are normative in the accompanying Markdown. No runtime application code executed.

AuthorizationClaims.$comment: All signature/scoping/context/body comparisons, expected epoch, key eligibility, first-write checks and policy_read_at<=iat<exp<=policy_read_at+issuer lifetime are mandatory runtime checks; Schema does not prove them.

OutputSchema.$comment: Runtime checks depth<=16, consistent keyword/type use, required keys in properties, min<=max, total body bound and adapter support. Only this subset is accepted; no $ref or external keyword in user schemas.

operator.X-Duranki-CSRF: current session CSRF token on mutations

x-runtime-rules: Cryptographic signature and exact header/body/context comparisons are mandatory.
No automatic POST retry, redirect, fallback, token renewal, epoch registration by inference, or replay recovery.
All unknown exposure/cancellation/epoch/financial state survives consumer restore and service restart.
Finite JSON numbers only; unsafe integers and duplicate decoded keys reject. Explicit null does not mean zero.
Generation model/space result bindings, role/candidate/destination/family/tools grants and all caps recheck at the qualified first-write fence.
Policy/issuer/generation/budget setup cannot bypass existing authenticated operator authorization and current revision publication.

x-correction.C1: Typed per-call assertions, trusted per-run binding, immutable signed admission and execution context; source H successor model reused
x-correction.C2: Formal conditional response/generation/error invariants plus runtime cross-record obligations
x-correction.C3: Future bound applies only to policy_read_at and iat; expiry has separate conservative comparison

x-runtime-cross-record-checks: Verify immutable binding content hash, tenant/issuer/principal and current actor/version, charging-owner grant, workflow/run constraints and evidence; asserted intermediate links confer no authority.
Recompute canonical work/assertion/admission/context digests and signatures; activation/assessments never enter logical effect identity.
CallStatus actual_model equals approved Generation.model and reported model resolves to it; operation, role and all compatibility constraints match admitted work.
Embedding vector count equals admitted input count, indexes preserve that order, coordinate count equals space.dimensions and space equals Generation.embedding_space/context.
Call identity equals nested failure/cancellation identities; financial and attribution rows/digests join original admitted records exactly.
Every Error top-level HTTP status equals its http_status; embedded failure http_status describes the execution error, not the GET/status envelope.
Recovery completion requires unfiltered whole-issuer complete snapshot with every page and current relevant high-water mark; selected filtered pages cannot qualify.
Budget refusal persists a consumed/refused reservation and ledger row atomically while tentative holds roll back; persistence uncertainty returns no durable acknowledgement.
Evaluate policy_read_at and iat against service_now_ms+margin_ms; evaluate expiry only by service_now_ms+margin_ms<1000*exp and original read-origin max lifetime.
